 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Buisness"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "Business".
 
• **English Meaning:** Business refers to an occupation, work, or trade involving the buying and selling of goods or services. (व्यवसाय)
 
 
• **Example:** She is starting her own business in the fashion industry.
 
 
 
• **Correct Word:** "Business" (व्यवसाय)
 
 
• **Example:** His business is growing rapidly due to his innovative ideas.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Buisness" is incorrectly spelled as "Business".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apology** (माफी): A regretful acknowledgment of an offense or failure.

 
 
• **Example:** He offered a sincere apology for arriving late.
 
 
 
• **Lecture** (व्याख्यान): A formal talk on a subject, usually given to an audience.
 
 
• **Example:** The professor delivered an engaging lecture on climate change.
 
 
 
• **Resource** (संसाधन): A stock or supply of money, materials, staff, and other assets that can be drawn on by a person or organization.
 
 
• **Example:** Natural resources like water and forests are essential for human survival.
